title: AAA 2026 to stream live worldwide on Disney+ from Kaohsiung
text:
AAA 2026 to stream live worldwide on Disney+ from Kaohsiung - CHOSUNBIZ 
 2026년 11월 6일(금) Industry Finance Real Estate IT Retail Science Policy Society International Entertainment Culture Sports English Entertainment AAA 2026 to stream live worldwide on Disney+ from Kaohsiung 
 입력 2026.11.06. 07:40 조선비즈 구글 검색 먼저 보기 'AAA 2026,' which proved its success and buzz by selling out 100,000 seats, will meet global fans as Disney+ confirms exclusive live global streaming.
 Star News is hosting and, organized by the AAA organizing committee, Motive and DShow, 'Asia Artist Awards (AAA 2026)' will spectacularly open over two days on Dec. 5 and 6 at Kaohsiung National Stadium, and will be exclusively broadcast live worldwide through Disney+. Locally, Sanli TV (SETTV, 三立電視), together with Disney+, will deliver the on-site atmosphere to living rooms with a one-hour delayed broadcast.
 'AAA 2026' will open with a red carpet at 3 p.m. on both days (local time), followed by the main awards ceremony starting at 5 p.m. Viewers around the world can enjoy the dazzling stages and the unforgettable award moments of global stars in real time through Disney+, feeling the full excitement of the festival.
 In particular, 'AAA 2026' drew an explosive response even before the event, with all 100,000 seats sold out. With both offline venues and online live streaming, it is expected to become the definitive year-end festival.
 The MC lineup leading this ceremony is also dazzling. Alongside 'AAA queen' Jang Wonyoung, who has served as an 'AAA' host for six consecutive years, actor Ji Changwook, and Sung Hanbin, who returns as a host after two years, and TZUYU will create a fantastic chemistry.
 The cast also boasts an all-time large scale. In the acting category, Go Youn-jung, Kim Seon-ho, Kim Soo-hyun, Kim You Jung, Kim Jaewon, Kim Hyeyoon, Dahyun (TWICE), Moon Sang Min, Michieda Shunsuke, Park Ji-hwan, Park Jihoon, Bae Jong-ok, Byeon Woo-seok, Ahn Hyo Seop, Yoon Kyung-ho, Lee Da-hee, Lee Sang Yi, Lee Jong-won, Lee Hongnae, Jang Da-ah, Choo Young-Woo, Heo Nam-jun, Heo Sung-tae, Hyeri and others will attend in large numbers to brighten the event.
 The music category also features top-tier artists such as Naniwadanzi, NEXG, Dayoung (WJSN), RIIZE, Longshot, RESCENE, MONSTA X, Miyao, Park Jihoon, Sung Hanbin, Super Junior-D&E, OURBIRTHDAY, IDIT, ALPHADRIVEONE, &TEAM, Accuse Five, ATEEZ, Xdinary Heroes, NMIXX, Yeonjun (TOMORROW X TOGETHER), ALLDAY PROJECT, Wooz, Wonpil (DAY6), Yuna (ITZY), ITZY, ZEROBASEONE, Jooheon (MONSTA X), Chaeryeong (ITZY), Yena, Cortis, QWER, Close Your Eyes, KISS OF LIFE, KiiiKiii, KickFlip, TOMORROW X TOGETHER, TWS, TUID, tripleS, Hearts2Hearts and others will gather to captivate fans worldwide.
